# Local browser dependencies

These are local copies of the versions already used by this site. No package manager or build step is required.

- Bootstrap 4.4.1 CSS: https://stackpath.bootstrapcdn.com/bootstrap/4.4.1/css/bootstrap.min.css (MIT; see bootstrap/LICENSE).
- Font Awesome 5.13.0 CSS and WOFF2 fonts: https://use.fontawesome.com/releases/v5.13.0/css/all.css (see fontawesome/LICENSE.txt).
- Academicons: the existing master stylesheet and matching font from https://github.com/jpswalsh/academicons, retrieved 2026-11-09. Font license and attribution are in academicons/OFL.txt; CSS license is MIT.
- CDRNet retains its original jQuery 3.5.1 version in cdrnet/static/js/jquery-3.5.1.min.js. The homepage uses its existing root-level jQuery 3.4.1 file.

Font stylesheets reference the bundled modern font format only (WOFF2 for Font Awesome, the original first-choice TrueType font for Academicons). Bootstrap's missing source-map reference was removed. All CSS rules and glyphs otherwise retain their upstream definitions.
